steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Film music uses leitmotifs (recurring themes for characters/ideas) — Williams' Star Wars themes are textbook examples of orchestral leitmotif technique.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Underscoring supports the on-screen action without dominating; hit points sync musical events with dramatic moments on screen.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Gaming music must be INTERACTIVE — it adapts to player actions through horizontal resequencing or vertical layering, unlike linear film scores.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Modern film/gaming scores blend orchestral instruments with synthesisers, sampled sounds and electronic production — hybrid scoring is now the norm.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always use PRECISE musical vocabulary — not vague descriptions like it sounds nice Reference SPECIFIC musical elements when analysing any piece For listening questions: identify elements FIRST, then explain their effect For study pieces: know the context, structure and key features in detail For performing: focus on accuracy, expression and interpretation For composing: show development of ideas, not just repetition
